# Cairn Careers

> A career-mapping tool for students that generates personalized dashboards with salary data, job growth projections, and step-by-step action plans.

Students input their interests, coursework, and experience to receive a nine-page dashboard covering resume guidance, LinkedIn, networking, interview prep, and a graduation-timeline roadmap.

Every page below is also available as Markdown: request it with `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (`/index.md` for the home page).

## Product

- [Home](https://cairncareers.com/): Overview of the career-mapping tool and how the dashboard is generated.
- [Methodology](https://cairncareers.com/methodology): How the AI-exposure score is calculated, naming and linking every source: O*NET occupational task data, the Eloundou et al. (2024) exposure framework in Science, and METR's long-run time-horizon trend. Pay and growth data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics is shown as context and never enters the score.
- [Roadmap](https://cairncareers.com/roadmap): Sample twelve-month roadmap, each month tied to a specific evidence gap and sequenced so the earliest work makes the later work easier.
- [CairnCareers vs asking ChatGPT](https://cairncareers.com/vs/chatgpt): Sourced federal task data and a term-by-term plan, compared with answers from a chatbot's training data.
- [CairnCareers vs CareerWing](https://cairncareers.com/vs/careerwing): A term-by-term roadmap for students built on linked sources, compared with CareerWing's 30/90/365-day plan and chat coach.
- [CairnCareers vs Career Mirror](https://cairncareers.com/vs/career-mirror): An AI-exposure score with every source linked, compared with Career Mirror's career intelligence tool.
- [CairnCareers vs Make the Leap](https://cairncareers.com/vs/maketheleap): A subscription roadmap that updates each term, compared with Make the Leap's one-time career reports.

## Support

- [Contact](https://cairncareers.com/contact): Form or details for reaching the Cairn Careers team.
- [Public API](https://cairncareers.com/docs/api.md): The form endpoints behind the site (signups, contact, beta count, health). OpenAPI spec at https://cairncareers.com/openapi.json; RFC 9727 catalog at https://cairncareers.com/.well-known/api-catalog.
- [MCP server](https://cairncareers.com/mcp/server-card): Read-only MCP server at https://cairncareers.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key) with tools to list pages, read any page as Markdown, and get the beta count.
- [Agent authentication](https://cairncareers.com/auth.md): auth.md for agents. Nothing public needs a key, and there is no agent registration or credential issuance.
- [Agent skills](https://cairncareers.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Agent Skills index with two skills, `cairncareers` (answering questions about the product from its own pages) and `explain-ai-exposure-score` (explaining what a score means and how it is calculated).
